name: kilroy
description: Kilroy — Local AI Agentic Software Engineering Platform for Windows 11

scripts.dev:hard-reset: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Process kilroy,msedgewebview2,node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force src-tauri\\target -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules\\\\.vite -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$cargoHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo'; $rustupHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.rustup'; $cargoBin = Join-Path $cargoHome 'bin'; $env:CARGO_HOME = $cargoHome; $env:RUSTUP_HOME = $rustupHome; $env:Path = $cargoBin + ';' + $env:Path; tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:dev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$cargoHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo'; $rustupHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.rustup'; $cargoBin = Join-Path $cargoHome 'bin'; $env:CARGO_HOME = $cargoHome; $env:RUSTUP_HOME = $rustupHome; $env:Path = $cargoBin + ';' + $env:Path; tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:dev:fresh: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path node_modules\\\\.vite) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules\\\\.vite }" && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$cargoHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo'; $rustupHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.rustup'; $cargoBin = Join-Path $cargoHome 'bin'; $env:CARGO_HOME = $cargoHome; $env:RUSTUP_HOME = $rustupHome; $env:Path = $cargoBin + ';' + $env:Path; tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$cargoHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo'; $rustupHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.rustup'; $cargoBin = Join-Path $cargoHome 'bin'; $env:CARGO_HOME = $cargoHome; $env:RUSTUP_HOME = $rustupHome; $env:Path = $cargoBin + ';' + $env:Path; tauri build"
scripts.cache:clear: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path node_modules\\\\.vite) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules\\\\.vite; Write-Host 'Vite cache cleared.' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'No Vite cache to clear.' -ForegroundColor DarkGray }"
scripts.build:release: npm run doctor && npm run fetch:ollama && npm run cache:clear && npm run tauri:build
scripts.bump: npm update && npm install && cd src-tauri && cargo update
scripts.bump:check: npm outdated --silent || true && cd src-tauri && cargo outdated --root-deps-only --depth 1 || true
